submitted.rationale: Mg–Sb–O compounds (MgO, Mg-rich antimonates, MgSb2O6 trirutile) have wide band gaps well above the 2.1 eV illumination, so I expected almost no photoresponse anywhere on the line. All five EQE measurements came out at the noise floor (|EQE| < 0.001%). Index 0 (Sb 0.085) gave the highest reading, 0.00092%, so I am submitting it, but its lead over the others is not meaningful.
